claims.text: Over the 14 days from the patch, the positive share was +2.3 points against the synthetic control estimate of what it would have been without the patch (90% range -1.0 to +4.2). That isn't enough to credit the patch: its 90% range includes no change at all.
Negative reviews mentioned the xeno arena update brought new game-breaking bugs.
There were 0 sale days and 0 discount days during the window.
Off-topic negative review mentions remained at 0.0% of negative reviews in the window.
The composition contribution to the review sentiment change was 0.14.
Total reviews in the window were 2289 compared to 2138 in the baseline period.

report.summary: Over the 14 days from the patch, the positive share was +2.3 points against the synthetic control estimate, with total reviews reaching 2289 compared to 2138 in the baseline period. Negative reviews mentioned the xeno arena update brought new game-breaking bugs, and the composition contribution to the review sentiment change was 0.14. There were 0 sale days and 0 discount days, while off-topic negative review mentions remained at 0.0 percent. The patch, a price change or sale, and off-topic reviews or a review bomb are inconclusive, while a change in who reviewed and noise or seasonality are rejected.
